descriptionPlain:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).
Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Join us as an Account Executive – Accountant Channel to turn France’s accounting firms into one of Qonto’s strongest growth channels. You’ll build your own pipeline of firms and close them end to end, under the guidance of Adrien Cannet, our Lead Accountant Channel.
➡️ What you’ll do
Build your own pipeline: You’ll source and prospect accounting firms across France, with no inbound to lean on.
Own the whole sales process end to end: qualify, understand how each firm works and where its pain sits and close the deal.
Turn firms into referral partners: You’ll get accountants recommending Qonto to their own client base.
Use AI to work smarter: You’ll lean on AI tools to prep calls, personalise outreach and speed up qualification.
➡️ What we’re looking for
Outbound experience: At least one year of full-time sales experience (CDI), with a track record of building your own pipeline.
You’ve closed a full cycle yourself: You’ve owned at least one deal end to end, from first call to signature.
You are fluent in French and English: Both are mandatory, with a minimum of C2 in French and C1+ in English.
You don’t quit: You keep working quiet accounts without losing energy or tact.
You’re AI-fluent: You use AI tools naturally to sharpen outreach, prep and follow-up.
➡️ What we can offer you
A channel with real impact: The accountant channel is one of Qonto’s strategic growth priorities, and it’s still being built.
Room to shape it: You’ll have the autonomy to test your own angles and help set the ways of working this team runs on.
Growth you earn: A clear growth path if you deliver.
Qonto’s sales school: Hands-on coaching and transferable skills that travel well.
➡️ Your future manager
You’ll report to Adrien Cannet, who leads the Account Executive team for the accountantchannel. With a strong SaaS sales background at Spendesk, Adrien joined Qonto via Regate in 2024 as an Account Executive and has since taken the lead on new business for the accountant channel. His management style is hands-on but empowering: through one-to-one coaching, he helps you get to the root of a stalled deal, sharpen your approach, and find a way forward, then trusts you to take the reins and close it yourself.

Join us as an Account Executive Accounting to help newly onboarded Qonto clients get their accounting right from day one. You'll be part of a strategic new positioning of Qonto, owning the full sales cycle yourself from first call to signed contract. Astrid Liska, our Sales Lead Accounting, will guide and mentor you closely every step of the way.
➡️ What you'll do
Engage clients right when it matters: You'll reach out to newly onboarded business creators within days of account creation and guide them to the right offer.
Stay on it when others give up: You’ll stay proactive with accounts that go quiet, following up thoughtfully and creating more opportunities to keep the conversation going.
Use a soft-selling approach: You'll diagnose each client's accounting needs and handle competitive and objection-based negotiation with confidence.
Close the deal: You’ll own the deal end to end, from the initial conversation through to the signed contract.
Use AI to work smarter: You'll lean on AI tools to prep calls, personalize outreach, and speed up qualification.
➡️ What we're looking for
You've closed before:At least 1 year of full-time sales experience (CDI), with closing experience and ownership of at least one full sales cycle from end to end. A strong closing rate is a plus.
You are fluent in French and English : Both are mandatory languages to master, with a minimum proficiency of C2 in French and C1+ in English.
You're comfortable on the phone: You reach out with confidence and build trust fast and bring a consultative mindset to every call.
You thrive in an early-stage environment: You're comfortable with processes that are still being created, like to give feedback and you adapt fast when things change.
You don't quit: You keep going on unresponsive accounts without losing energy or tact.
You're AI-fluent: You use AI tools naturally to sharpen outreach, prep, and follow-up.
➡️ What we can offer you
A brand-new team with real stakes: You'll help build one of Qonto's strategic priorities for 2027, from the ground up. You'll help shape a new path at Qonto and experience its early stages firsthand.
A space to try, learn and build: You'll have the autonomy to test ideas and help establish the ways of working that will set this new team up for success.
Growth you earn: Challenge yourself, grow through your achievements, and see your impact translate into real growth at Qonto.
Qonto's sales school: Hands-on coaching and transferable skills that open doors and are a real launchpad.
➡️ Your future manager
You'll report to Astrid Liska, Sales Lead Accounting. Before Qonto, she built her sales career at Qobra and PayFit France, and she's the one who built Qonto's Regate SDR team from scratch. She's now taking on the same build-from-zero challenge with this new accounting team.
Having evolved from an SDR to an Account Executive and Key Account Manager before stepping into leadership, she has mastered every stage of the sales cycle and understands exactly what it takes to perform and grow in this environment.
Astrid is dedicated to building a collaborative and high-performing team. She uses her diverse experience to provide concrete mentorship, helping you sharpen your skills and navigate complex sales challenges to reach your full potential.

You thrive in an early-stage environment: You're comfortable with processes that are still being created, like to give feedback and you adapt fast when things change.
You don't quit: You keep going on unresponsive accounts without losing energy or tact.
You're AI-fluent: You use AI tools naturally to sharpen outreach, prep, and follow-up.
➡️ What we can offer you
A brand-new team with real stakes: You'll help build one of Qonto's strategic priorities for 2027, from the ground up. You'll help shape a new path at Qonto and experience its early stages firsthand.
A space to try, learn and build: You'll have the autonomy to test ideas and help establish the ways of working that will set this new team up for success.
Growth you earn: Challenge yourself, grow through your achievements, and see your impact translate into real growth at Qonto.
Qonto's sales school: Hands-on coaching and transferable skills that open doors and are a real launchpad.
➡️ Your future manager
You'll report to Astrid Liska, Sales Lead Accounting. Before Qonto, she built her sales career at Qobra and PayFit France, and she's the one who built Qonto's Regate SDR team from scratch. She's now taking on the same build-from-zero challenge with this new accounting team.
Having evolved from an SDR to an Account Executive and Key Account Manager before stepping into leadership, she has mastered every stage of the sales cycle and understands exactly what it takes to perform and grow in this environment.
Astrid is dedicated to building a collaborative and high-performing team. She uses her diverse experience to provide concrete mentorship, helping you sharpen your skills and navigate complex sales challenges to reach your full potential.

descriptionPlain:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).
Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Join us as an Anti-Financial Crime Analyst (DE) in our Belgrade office to investigate and report suspicious activities, ensuring Qonto's compliance with German AML/CFT regulations. You'll join our Anti-Financial Crime team and work closely with Ludmila Moroniewicz, our Lead Anti-Financial Crime Germany & CDD, to protect our growing German client base from financial crime risks.
➡️ What you'll do
Investigate and report: Perform enhanced investigations on suspicious client activities and issue Suspicious Transaction Reports (STR) to the German FIU when necessary.
Ensure reporting quality: Detect and describe patterns on investigated accounts to ensure regulatory reports meet the highest standards.
Handle team escalations: Investigate cases escalated by the transaction monitoring team, assess risk, and recommend next steps.
Strengthen the AFC framework: Contribute to improving investigation processes and documentation standards as Qonto's German operations scale.
➡️ What we're looking for

Join us as an Anti-Financial Crime Analyst (DE) in our Belgrade office to investigate and report suspicious activities, ensuring Qonto's compliance with German AML/CFT regulations. You'll join our Anti-Financial Crime team and work closely with Ludmila Moroniewicz, our Lead Anti-Financial Crime Germany & CDD, to protect our growing German client base from financial crime risks.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Investigate and report: Perform enhanced investigations on suspicious client activities and issue Suspicious Transaction Reports (STR) to the German FIU when necessary.
  • Ensure reporting quality: Detect and describe patterns on investigated accounts to ensure regulatory reports meet the highest standards.
  • Handle team escalations: Investigate cases escalated by the transaction monitoring team, assess risk, and recommend next steps.
  • Strengthen the AFC framework: Contribute to improving investigation processes and documentation standards as Qonto's German operations scale.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • AML/Financial Crime experience: You have first experience in AML, Financial Crime, or Compliance — ideally in fintech or banking. You've handled real cases, not just studied the theory.
  • Analytical rigor: You have a logical mind and can analyze complex datasets, spot errors, and build well-reasoned investigation conclusions.
  • Quality and throughput: You deliver high-quality work while managing multiple cases in parallel — you know how to prioritise without cutting corners.
  • German proficiency: Native or C1 German is required for this role. Fluent English as well.
Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Real investigative work: You'll handle STRs, enhanced due diligence, and escalation reviews — not back-office monitoring. The cases are complex and the stakes are real.
  • A market you'll help build: Qonto's German AFC processes were built from scratch. You'll contribute to an operation that's still being shaped, not just maintained.
  • Investigative culture: The team values logical thinking and curiosity — understanding the why behind a transaction matters more than ticking a checklist.
  • Belgrade office: Join a multicultural team in our Belgrade hub, working on German-market cases with direct exposure to European AML regulation.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Ludmila Moroniewicz, our Lead Anti-Financial Crime Germany & CDD.

  • Her path? 9 years in Money Laundering prevention in fintech — from KYC/KYB roles to AFC Lead, reporting directly to the MLRO of Qonto's German branch. She contributed to launching Qonto's operations in Germany and built the Financial Crime processes for the German market from scratch. Her Global CDD Expert role gave her an overview of KYC/KYB processes across all Qonto markets.
  • What does she bring to the team? A hands-on leadership style that fosters continuous learning and professional growth. She knows the German regulatory landscape inside out and gives her team the autonomy to own their investigations.
